'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive|2022 Ukrainian summer counteroffensive]]
***Multiple explosions are reported at a [[Russian military]] air base near [[Novofedorivka]] in western [[Crimea]]. At least one person is killed and six others are injured, according to [[Council of Ministers of Crimea|Crimean authorities]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/loud-explosions-heard-near-russian-military-airbase-crimea-witnesses-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)] [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-one-dead-as-russia-insists-explosions-at-crimea-air-base-caused-by-detonation-of-ammunition-not-attack-12669385 (Sky News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Ibrahim al-Nabulsi, local head of the [[al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades]], and two other people are killed during a raid by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] in [[Nablus]]. At least 40 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-62476488 (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Four [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldiers]] are killed in a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] in [[Mir Ali, Pakistan|Mir Ali]], [[North Waziristan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/suicide-attack-kills-four-pakistani-soldiers-army-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**Fifteen [[Burkina Faso Armed Forces|troops]] are killed when their vehicle hits a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] in [[Bam Province]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/roadside-bomb-kills-15-soldiers-northern-burkina-faso-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Four civilians and a [[Cameroon Armed Forces|soldier]] are killed, and another civilian is wounded, during three separate attacks by [[Boko Haram]] gunmen in the [[Far North Region, Cameroon|Far North Region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://english.news.cn/20220810/ec46d1026958463b9b42f873ccb655d7/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Transneft]] says that [[Ukraine]] has suspended Russian oil flows through the [[Druzhba pipeline]] to the [[Czech Republic]], [[Hungary]] and [[Slovakia]] after it was unable to pay transit fees to Ukraine's pipeline operator [[UkrTransNafta]]. The Czech Republic's pipeline company says it expects supplies through the pipeline to restart within several days. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-suspends-oil-exports-via-southern-leg-druzhba-pipeline-due-transit-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/9/russian-oil-transit-via-ukraine-halted-due-to-western-sanctions (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 South Korean floods]]
**Nine people are killed by flooding caused by record-breaking rainfall in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/seoul-south-korea-1ef71e9146bdf2114ecf7986269e0db8 (AP)]
*[[Matanzas oil storage facility explosion]]
**[[Firefighter]]s in [[Cuba]] bring a catastrophic fire at an [[oil terminal]] in [[Matanzas Province|Matanzas]] under control after it burned out of control for five consecutive days, destroying 40% of the country's main fuel storage facility and causing widespread [[power outage|blackouts]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/cuba-still-struggling-with-oil-depot-fire-worst-islands-history-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Marshall Islands]]
***The [[Marshall Islands]] confirm their first [[community transmission]] cases of [[COVID-19]] in the capital [[Majuro]]. The government subsequently announces that the start of the school year will be delayed and suspends flights and boat travel to the country's outer islands. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/472498/marshall-islands-sees-first-covid-19-spread (RNZ)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**Russia bans the import of agricultural products from [[Moldova]] from August 15 due to "repeated detection of dangerous [[quarantine]] objects in Moldovan products entering Russia". [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-restricts-imports-agriculture-products-moldova-2022-08-09/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A man is arrested for the killings of three Pakistani men last month and for the murder of an [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] man in November 2021 in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]], [[United States]]. The alleged killer targeted the victims "because he was angry over his daughter marrying a [[Shia Islam|Shiite Muslim]]"; all the victims were Shiite. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/9/albuquerque-police-arrest-suspect-in-killing-of-us-muslim-men (Al Jazeera)]
*The driver of a pickup truck that collided with a motorcycle procession and killed seven people in [[Randolph, New Hampshire]], United States in 2019 is acquitted on all charges. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/08/09/us/new-hampshire-truck-driver-acquitted.html (''New York Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Kenyan general election]]
**[[Kenyans]] vote in a [[general election]]. [https://nation.africa/kenya/photos/decision-2022-kenyans-go-to-the-ballot-3907978 (''Daily Nation'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Radio astronomers have discovered a newborn, [[Jupiter]]-size [[exoplanet]] orbiting the star AS 209, using the [[Atacama Large Millimeter Array]] telescope in [[Chile]]. [https://www.space.com/planetary-nursery-baby-world-gas-detection (Space.com)]
*[[Roscosmos]] launches the [[Iranian Space Agency]]'s [[Earth observation satellite]] ''Khayyam'' from the [[Baikonur Cosmodrome]] in [[Kazakhstan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/9/russia-launches-iranian-satellite-into-space-from-kazakhstan-base (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[44th Chess Olympiad]]
**The [[Chess Olympiad]] in [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]], concludes, with [[Uzbeks|Uzbek]] [[Chess prodigy|chess]] grandmaster [[Nodirbek Abdusattorov]] winning the [[Open event at the 44th Chess Olympiad|open event]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/chess/uzbek-chess-more-than-just-abdusattorov-triumph-at-chess-olympiad-is-our-independence-day-gift-to-uzbekistan-says-coach-8081038/ (''The Indian Express'')]
